meta.title: Money Collected per Hour at a Toll Plaza (Rush Hour)

prompt: How much money is collected per hour during rush hour at a toll plaza on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway?

clarifications.answer: Assume an average toll of Rs 50 per vehicle.
Assume cashless (FASTag), so each vehicle clears quickly.

common_traps: Using minutes instead of seconds per vehicle, undercounting throughput by 60x.
Forgetting to multiply single-lane throughput by the number of lanes.
Assuming peak capacity holds all day rather than only during rush hour.

anchors.1: No rate logic; guesses vehicles or revenue directly without service time, lanes, and toll.
anchors.3: Has the throughput-times-toll idea but omits lanes or service-time reasoning.
anchors.5: Recognises this as a supply-rate problem: throughput per lane times lanes times toll.

anchors.1: Treats the plaza as a single undifferentiated flow with no per-lane build-up.
anchors.3: Reasons per lane but doesn't cleanly scale to all lanes, or double-counts.
anchors.5: Builds from per-lane per-second service time up to all lanes, cleanly.

anchors.1: Uses minutes instead of seconds per vehicle, undercounting throughput roughly 60x, or a similar large error.
anchors.3: Gets throughput right but slips on the final multiplication or the toll figure.

anchors.1: No plausibility check on the vehicle count or revenue.
anchors.3: Comments the number 'seems fine' without testing it against plaza capacity.
anchors.5: Comments on whether 3600 vehicles/hour is plausible for a busy 8-lane plaza.
